boards.name: Campaign strategy
boards.description: Define a campaign’s objective, audience, insight, idea, key messages, channel roles and measures before creative work starts.

cards.title: Campaign strategy — “Pause, don’t cancel”
cards.body: Retention campaign for Hollow Oak’s subscription: stop people cancelling when life gets busy.

cards.title: How to use this template
cards.body: Read left to right as an argument: problem → audience → insight → idea → messages → channels → measures. If one card doesn’t follow from the last, the strategy isn’t finished.

cards.title: Problem
cards.body: 38% of subscribers cancel within 4 months — mostly “too much coffee” or “away”.

cards.title: Audience
cards.body: Subscribers in months 2–4, especially those who skip a delivery.

cards.title: Insight
cards.body: Cancelling feels like failing a habit. Pausing feels like a holiday.

cards.title: Idea
cards.body: **Pause, don’t cancel.** Make pausing the hero: easy, friendly, guilt-free.

cards.title: Messages
cards.body:
- Off on holiday? Pause in one tap.
- Too much coffee? Go monthly.
- Come back whenever.
